page_title: Rittal — Enclosures, Power, Cooling & IT Infrastructure
intro_paragraphs:
Rittal is a leading global manufacturer of industrial and IT enclosures, power distribution, climate control, and modular data center systems. Its system-based approach — enclosures, power, cooling, and monitoring engineered to work together — makes infrastructure simpler to design, install, and scale.

Octel Networks distributes Rittal's product range and delivers it as physical infrastructure — from a single equipment rack to a fully modular data center — for server rooms, data centers, and industrial control environments.
portfolio_subtitle: System-based infrastructure engineered for durability, efficiency, and scale.
portfolio_cards:
ri-archive-2-line | Enclosures | Industrial and IT enclosures/cabinets standardized for server rooms, factory floors, and outdoor installations.
ri-flashlight-line | Power Distribution | Power distribution systems designed to safely and efficiently deliver power, integrated with Rittal's broader enclosure and cooling ecosystem.
ri-temp-cold-line | Climate Control | Precision cooling solutions, including the Blue e+S range, engineered to reduce energy consumption while keeping equipment within safe operating temperatures.
ri-stack-line | IT Infrastructure (RiMatrix) | Modular data center systems that align racks, power, cooling, monitoring, and physical security into one scalable platform.
ri-settings-4-line | Automation Systems | Automation-ready enclosure and panel-building solutions integrated with Rittal's Eplan software ecosystem.
ri-apps-2-line | System Accessories & Software | Configuration tools and accessories that let customers plan, order, and standardize infrastructure builds efficiently.
whatwedo_intro: System-level infrastructure design and deployment, not piecemeal components:
whatwedo_items:
System Design | Racks, power, cooling, and monitoring planned as one integrated system
Faster Deployment | Pre-configured, standardized enclosure systems to cut installation time
Scalable Data Center Design | Infrastructure that expands with future capacity needs, without redesigning
Local Implementation | On-site installation and commissioning support
After-Sales Support | Ongoing maintenance and warranty support

intro_paragraphs:
R&M (Reichle & De-Massari AG) is a Swiss, family-owned company with over 60 years of experience engineering structured cabling and connectivity systems for LAN, data center, and public network infrastructure. Its system-based design — where every cable, connector, and panel is built to work together — is engineered for long-term reliability rather than short-term fixes.

Octel Networks is an authorized distributor of R&M in the region. We take R&M's product range from spec sheet to deployed infrastructure — handling design, supply, installation, and certification so customers get a single point of accountability for their entire cabling backbone.
portfolio_subtitle: Certified, standards-compliant cabling systems built for offices, data centers, and public networks.
portfolio_cards:
ri-router-line | Local Area Network (LAN) Cabling | Structured copper and fiber cabling for offices, digital buildings, residential, industrial, and healthcare sites — including WLAN cabling, Single Pair Ethernet, and digital ceiling systems for connected buildings.
ri-database-2-line | Data Center Cabling | Integrated cabling across building entrance facilities, meet-me rooms, computer rooms, and edge/containment systems — designed to keep pace with rising bandwidth and density demands.
ri-signal-tower-line | Public Network Infrastructure | Outside plant, central office, and fiber-to-the-antenna (FTTA) cabling solutions purpose-built for telecom operators, utilities, smart cities, and railway networks.
ri-cpu-line | OEM & Fiber Optic Components | Fiber optic connectivity components and custom-assembled solutions for OEMs and system integrators building their own networking equipment.
ri-dashboard-3-line | Infrastructure Management (inteliPhy) | Automated Infrastructure Management (AIM) and DCIM software that gives IT teams real-time visibility and control over the physical cabling layer.
whatwedo_intro: End-to-end delivery so R&M infrastructure is installed right the first time, and stays supported after go-live:
whatwedo_items:
Design & BOQ Planning | Cabling architecture and bill-of-quantities aligned to R&M's certified system design
Certified Installation | Deployment by installers trained under R&M's Qualified Partner program
Testing & Certification | End-to-end link testing and system warranty certification
Local Stock & Lead Times | Regionally stocked components to avoid long import delays
After-Sales Support | Ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and warranty support
summary_bullets:
Structured LAN & Fiber Cabling
Data Center Cabling & inteliPhy Management
Public Network & OEM Fiber Components

page_title: NETKA System — RegTech, OpsTech & AI Solutions
intro_paragraphs:
NETKA System is a Thailand-based technology company delivering AI-powered software platforms that bring IT observability, cybersecurity, service management, and data privacy compliance together under one stack — instead of forcing IT teams to stitch together disconnected point tools.

Octel Networks deploys and supports NETKA's platform suite for organizations that need real-time visibility into their IT environment and audit-ready compliance, without building these capabilities in-house. We handle implementation, integration with existing infrastructure, and ongoing support.
portfolio_subtitle: AI-driven platforms covering IT operations, security, service management, and compliance.
portfolio_cards:
ri-radar-line | IT Observability (NNMX) | NetkaView Network Manager X delivers real-time network monitoring, application performance monitoring (APM), and wireless access point (WAP) management from a single console.
ri-shield-keyhole-line | IT Security — SIEM & SOAR (NLG) | NetkaView Logger combines SIEM and SOAR capabilities — threat detection, log analysis, and regulatory compliance reporting.
ri-customer-service-2-line | IT Service Management (NSDX) | NetkaQuartz Service Desk X streamlines service operations, incident management, change enablement, and IT asset management.
ri-lock-2-line | Data Privacy Management (NDPP) | Cookie consent, privacy notices, Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), DPIA, and breach response — aligned to GDPR, India's DPDP Act, and other regional privacy laws.
ri-brain-line | AI for IT Ops (N-AIOps) | Predictive analytics and event correlation that help IT teams detect and resolve issues before they affect the business.
ri-leaf-line | ESG & Governance (EnXus / EnTrust) | Carbon accounting, sustainability reporting, and governance, risk & compliance (GRC) management for organizations building out ESG programs.
whatwedo_intro: Implementation, integration, and ongoing support across NETKA's platform suite:
whatwedo_items:
Deployment & Integration | On-premise, cloud, or hybrid rollout integrated with existing IT and security tools
Compliance Alignment | Configuration mapped to GDPR, DPDP, and ITIL frameworks
Unified Support | Single point of contact across security, observability, ITSM, and compliance modules
Flexible Licensing | Software, hardware appliance, or SaaS delivery based on customer need
Training & Enablement | Onboarding and admin training for internal IT teams
summary_bullets:
IT Observability & AIOps
SIEM/SOAR Security & ITSM
Data Privacy & ESG Compliance
